data.text: Luke, you’ve just joined us, and I’d rather welcome you as a partner than lose the lake competing with you. I learned to fish here from my family; I want our village’s children to have that same chance. I won’t encourage John or anyone else to race you to the bottom. At 10 tons each per month, you’d earn $120,000 over a year—more than the $100,000 from emptying the lake once. I’ll commit to 10 tons, with everyone’s catches reviewed together each month. Will you withdraw your demand and agree to that limit?
